newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three unleaded diffs firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent Group Three unleaded diffs firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials for September deliveries firmed Monday in Group Three on increased demand, traders said.
"There seems to be some shorts covering positions in the Group," one trader said of the strength in prompt September barrels as discussion opened for the final week of the month.
Chicago unleaded was steady and distillate differentials in the Midwest markets were unchanged in morning discussion, traders said.

Group Three prompt unleaded gasoline firmed to bids 0.25 cent a gallon under the print, up 0.50 cent a gallon in early morning discussion. Later deliveries were steady at bids 0.75 cent under the print and premium remained 2.50 cents higher.
Chicago late-September unleaded gasoline remained 1.50/1.25 cents under the print with premium talked 2.75 cents higher.
Gasoline basis was pushed lower by a more than one cent a gallon decline in front-month unleaded prices in midday NYMEX trade.
Low and high sulphur diesel fuel differentials were unchanged in both markets, and jet/kero was steady, leaving basis in the distillates to track falling NYMEX front-month heating oil prices.
